Definition: Noach, the patriarch of the flood
BiblicalUsage: Noah = "rest"; 1) son of Lamech, father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth; builder of the ark which saved his family from the destruction of the world which God sent on the world by the flood; became the new seminal head of mankind because his family were the only survivors of the flood
